entities.summary: Liam Brian Williams is a former Welsh professional rugby union player who played for Newcastle Red Bulls in Premiership Rugby. At international level, he has represented Wales, having made his test debut against New Zealand in 2012, and the British & Irish Lions in 2017 and 2021. Williams has previously played for Scarlets, Cardiff and Kubota Spears.
